tables.name: accounts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(provider) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  provider_account_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(provider_account_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (provider, provider_account_id)
)

tables.name: bookmarks
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE bookmarks (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(item_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, item_id)
)

tables.name: discovery_state
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE discovery_state (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'news' CHECK(target_type='news'),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK(status IN ('not_started','in_progress','completed')),
  bookmarked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(bookmarked IN (0,1)),
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(user_id,item_id)
)

tables.name: item_progress
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_progress (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(item_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed')),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (position >= 0),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, item_id)
)

tables.name: notes
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE notes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scope_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_type IN ('item', 'stage')),
  scope_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) <= 20000),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (user_id, scope_type, scope_id)
)

tables.name: operational_metrics
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE operational_metrics (
  bucket_started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  event TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event IN (
    'page_view',
    'request_error',
    'login_failure',
    'health_check',
    'backup',
    'restore',
    'content_audit',
    'materials_update'
  )),
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN (
    'home',
    'roadmap',
    'roadmap-stage',
    'courses',
    'course-detail',
    'reader',
    'search',
    'projects',
    'learning',
    'login',
    'content-policy',
    'contribute',
    'admin',
    'learning-state',
    'data-export',
    'github-login',
    'readiness',
    'backup',
    'restore',
    'content-audit',
    'materials-update'
  )),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN (
    'observed',
    'success',
    'client-error',
    'server-error',
    'failure'
  )),
  count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (count >= 0),
  last_occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (bucket_started_at, event, scope, outcome)
)

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
      version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

tables.name: sessions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(token_hash) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: stage_outcomes
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE stage_outcomes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  stage_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(stage_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('repository', 'demo', 'reflection')),
  url TEXT,
  summary TEXT CHECK (summary IS NULL OR length(summary) <= 20000),
  confirmed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: stage_task_progress
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE stage_task_progress (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(task_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completed IN (0, 1)),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, task_id)
)

tables.name: users
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('cloud', 'local')),
  github_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: admin_actions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_actions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  target TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: discovery_migrations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE discovery_migrations (
  version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: editions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE editions (
  day TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  cutoff INTEGER NOT NULL,
  entries TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: github_result_files
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE github_result_files (
            source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
            path TEXT NOT NULL,
            sha TEXT NOT NULL,
            commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL, record_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', parser_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rejected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error_code TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(source_id,path)
          )

tables.name: item_merges
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_merges (
            source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id),
            target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            CHECK(source_id<>target_id)
          )

tables.name: item_urls
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_urls (
            url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id)
          )

tables.name: item_versions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  input TEXT NOT NULL,
  processing_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  output TEXT,
  processing_version TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(item_id,content_hash)
)

tables.name: items
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  published_version TEXT,
  pending_version TEXT,
  publication_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(publication_state IN ('draft','published','withdrawn')),
  protected_fields TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  first_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  published_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: jobs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  unique_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','waiting','completed','failed','cancelled')),
  priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  available_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lease_token TEXT,
  lease_until INTEGER,
  heartbeat_at INTEGER,
  checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  result TEXT,
  error_code TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: metric_observations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE metric_observations (
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
  observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  metrics TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(item_id,source_id,observed_at)
)

tables.name: model_receipts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE model_receipts (
  call_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  budget_day TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','dispatched','succeeded','released','unknown')),
  reserved_micros INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved_micros >= 0),
  actual_micros INTEGER CHECK(actual_micros >= 0),
  price_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  exchange_rate REAL NOT NULL,
  provider_request_id TEXT,
  result TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: proposals
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),
  config TEXT NOT NULL,
  branch TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pr_number INTEGER,
  pr_url TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: settings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE settings (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: source_records
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_records (
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item_versions(id),
  last_seen_run TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present',
  source_status TEXT,
  upstream_updated_at INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY(source_id,record_id)
)

tables.name: sources
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  config TEXT NOT NULL,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
  next_sync_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_success_at INTEGER,
  upstream_updated_at INTEGER,
  last_error TEXT,
  progress TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

tables.name: temporary_content
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE temporary_content (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item_versions(id),
  filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  fetched_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: worker_health
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE worker_health (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  heartbeat_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  current_job TEXT
)
